properties.name: Body or NPC embedded in ground
properties.check: Is an NPC or corpse partially inside the ground — head sticking out above the surface, body buried below, or stuck upside-down emerging from the floor?

properties.name: Body clips through solid structure
properties.check: Does a corpse or NPC mesh pass through a fence, door, gate, or wall? Look for body parts visibly on both sides of a barrier that should block them.

properties.name: Creature or NPC launched into sky
properties.check: Is a creature (deathclaw, assaultron, raider) catapulted unnaturally high into the sky? The upward force should be vastly disproportionate to the cause — far beyond normal combat knockback.

properties.name: Characters float or slide through air in combat
properties.check: Are characters hovering or drifting through the air during melee combat — swinging weapons while their feet have no ground contact and no jumping animation is playing?

properties.name: Limb animation distortion
properties.check: Are a character's legs or arms twisting, rotating through the body, or bending in a physically impossible direction? Look for limbs that clip through the torso or spin unnaturally.

properties.name: Object spinning or rolling on flat ground
properties.check: Is a box, crate, or other prop spinning, rotating, or rolling across a flat surface on its own, with no character or explosion acting on it?

properties.name: Rendering corruption or geometry hole
properties.check: Are background textures corrupted, missing, or showing the void? Is the player character stuck inside a wall with the camera showing both rooms simultaneously?

properties.name: NPC stuck in repetitive dialogue loop
properties.check: Does an NPC repeat the same single voice line continuously without player interaction?

properties.name: Persistent combat music after enemies are gone
properties.check: Does intense combat music continue playing long after all enemies are eliminated and danger status is cleared?

properties.name: Interface frozen but game continues
properties.check: Does the screen remain stuck on a tab (Inventory, Map, Stats) while the world continues moving in the background? Player cannot switch tabs or close normally.

properties.name: Third-person camera stuck inside character
properties.check: Does the third-person camera zoom extremely close into the player's back or inside the character model, blocking visibility, and not reset after switching perspective?

properties.name: Missing world objects
properties.check: The game is being loaded without the actual objects and it's only the main character in the game.
